data.description:
FIGHT with any weapon you can find against different enemies in the Hex7 Arenas. 
DEFEND yourself with shield and sword and don't forget to RELOAD your guns once in awhile.
                                                                                                                                                                       
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031640_1611492052972544_8434024045580790583_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=EqwhdoGe65oQ7kNvgEfdg7M&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA2GskTG1GsIqxL_UMbYBRZCFinA2F-5PheXrmYnqjdGg&oe=675C2E8C)
SURVIVE the first 7 ROUNDS.
Have FUN customizing your game as much as you like.
![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39035393_1502492917145105_2500292279720560247_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=mI2Q3bJkKU0Q7kNvgEt4FQR&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-lga3-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBg3O4e4RLs6OCt5JA95U25U7OH71DPpq6NAZeBuDFaFw&oe=675C2C9F)
EXPLORE the Arenas and enjoy the different game modes.
